tools.name: publish_page
tools.description: Publish a new HTML (or Markdown) page to the maker's PubSpace space and get back a live, shareable URL to hand to the human. tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Replace the content of an existing page in place: the same URL serves the new content immediately, so links the human already shared keep working. tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page in the maker's space, newest first, with no paging: { total, pages: [{ id, title, url, project, views, live, workEmailGated, hasDraft, createdAt, updatedAt }] }. Read-only. Use it to find a page_id before update_page / get_page / unpublish_page / delete_page, or to reuse an existing

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch one page by id: metadata always ({ id, title, url, project, views, live, workEmailGated, hasDraft, createdAt, updatedAt, visibility }), plus the stored HTML when include_html is true. tools.name: unpublish_page
tools.description: Take a page offline without deleting it: its URL shows an "offline" notice to viewers, and the content, id, URL and view count are kept. Pass restore: true to put it back online at the same URL. Prefer this over delete_page when the human wants a page hidden or paused. Calling it twice is harmless.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page: its URL stops working at once. The maker gets only a brief undo in the dashboard, then it is purged for good (there is no restore tool). Only use it when the human asked for deletion; to hide a page reversibly, use unpublish_page instead. Returns { ok, id, deleted }; fails with page_n

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, get_page, unpublish_page · Public sink: publish_page · Destructive: delete_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, get_page, unpublish_page · Public sink: publish_page · Destructive: delete_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
